scenarios.title: Search assets by partial asset name
preconditions: Catalog page is loaded with default assets displayed
scenarios.expectedResult: Only 'Customer Master' is displayed in the search results.

scenarios.title: Search assets by partial owner name
preconditions: Catalog page is loaded with default assets displayed
scenarios.expectedResult: Only 'Sales Transactions' owned by 'Finance Data' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Filter assets by asset type API
preconditions: Catalog page is loaded displaying all available assets
steps: Select 'API' from the asset type filter dropdown
scenarios.expectedResult: Only 'Product Reference API' asset is listed.

scenarios.title: Clear active asset type filters
preconditions: An asset type filter such as 'Table' is currently applied
scenarios.expectedResult: The active filter is cleared and all standard catalog assets are displayed.

scenarios.title: View asset details
preconditions: Catalog page is loaded with listed assets
steps: Click on the 'Supplier Data Feed' asset title from the catalog list
scenarios.expectedResult: The detail view opens displaying full information for 'Supplier Data Feed' owned by 'Procurement Ops' with type 'File'.

scenarios.title: Search asset name with mixed case text
Search asset name with leading and trailing whitespace
steps: Enter '   Customer Master   ' into the search input
scenarios.expectedResult: Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored and 'Customer Master' is displayed.

scenarios.title: Search with non-existent asset name
scenarios.expectedResult: No assets are displayed in the search results.
